macros.name: b
macros.doc: \b which does draw a bond in a given direction (the first binding parameter) and set an optional label taken in square brackets.

macros.name: b
macros.doc: \b which does draw a bond in a given direction (the first binding parameter) and set an optional label taken in square brackets.

macros.name: defwmode
macros.doc: To obtain a more bold formula one may either use * before every bond or say \defwmode=1 in the beginning of a document (\defwmode=0 returns the normal thickness).

macros.name: Me
macros.doc: A shorter command \Me may be used instead, so that 2\Me is equivalent to [2{CH$_3$}] (any other number designating a bond direction may take place of digit 2 here).

macros.name: msdir
macros.doc: Default \msdir=1 means the common direction — upward; any other value make peaks to be oriented downward.

macros.name: OH
macros.doc: The logic of \OH itself is limited to the choice of either label OH or HO depending on a bond direction.

macros.name: sx
macros.doc: Variables \sx and \sy contain offsets used for a bond if its direction equals a conditional value of 30 hours.

macros.name: vpos
macros.doc: assignment \vpos=1 switches on the bottom alignment (i. e., the box depth equals zero).
